visual.general_description: Line chart of myoglobin against time in days with a green arrow annotation about levothyroxine.
visual.detailed_description: White-background line chart with a red line joining four small black point markers. The x-axis is titled "Time (Days)" with tick labels Day 1, Day 4, Day 30 and Day 39. The y-axis is titled "Myoglobin (ng/ml)" with tick labels 0, 500, 1,000, 1,500, 2,000, 2,500. The line falls steeply from the first marker to the second and then continues to fall more gradually through the third and fourth markers. A green left-pointing arrow beside the first marker sits next to a white text box printed "Levothyroxine 125mcg started at day 1". No chart title, legend or per-point value labels are printed.
